mentions.name: Cranki
mentions.description: This free PWA generates crossword puzzles from the user's Anki flashcard lists, making vocabulary practice more fun than plain flashcards. It runs entirely locally with no server or database, and works on both mobile and desktop.
mentions.problem: Language learners often find flashcards boring, and this offers crosswords as a fun alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt: I recently built Cranki [0], a free little PWA that generates crosswords using your Anki flashcard lists. It's aimed at language learners (who find flashcards boring and crossword fun!).
